reason: The cited handler sends validated parameters to a browser socket command to select an option, then calls getUrl, getTitle, and browser_snapshot and returns those values in the tool response. This establishes reading and returning browser page state/content, which may include non-public page data, and the page URL/title/snapshot are also potentially attacker-controlled web content. The select-option command also sends agent-supplied parameters into the browser/page context, which can be observed by the page. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution.
